# C32 — Archetype

## #0

The image appears with a force its visible content cannot contain. It gathers associations, redistributes feeling and draws a life along paths no single interpretation commands. **Archetype** names the generative organisation made legible through such variable manifestations; the archetype as such does not appear as a final content-object beside them. The [arche-topos](../A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field.md) is the wider field of possible differentiation; archetypal organisation gives this field a specifically psychic and symbolic office.

## #1

A dream, god, number, symptom, fantasy, narrative, concept or bodily intensity can become an [archetypal manifestation](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md). The particular image gives an unknown ordering relation a local face. Its excess over a settled interpretation keeps that face open to further manifestation. [Image and valuation](C33-Image-Valuation.md) concern the determinate image and its investment; this particularity remains distinct from the generative organisation.

The broken symbolon's seam makes the relation tangible. One half carries the shape of a counterpart it cannot manufacture alone; recognition depends on their relation. An image can similarly make its absent or unexhausted condition operative. A [living symbol](C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md) keeps this relation active; an idol installs its image as the exhaustive identity of its source.

## #2

In native QL, `0/1` retains unrepresentable ground and representable mark through their relating stroke; `X/x` differentiates determining capacity from its indefinite particular. Archetypal recurrence is Taylor's psychic instantiation of this already derived relation. Across distinct images, the determining capacity becomes legible without becoming another image. The notation is authorial QL, not Jung's.

Through [the eight determinations](../A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md), pattern retains its life: appearance questions, attracts and repels, gathers into recurrence, stakes a first-person relation and effects a particular transformation before returning toward its source. This is the author's cross-register movement. It does not make the sequence a historical Jungian derivation or reduce symbolic experience to six labels.

## #3

An attractor and a trajectory articulate different aspects of the dynamic comparison. A trajectory is an actual history through a state-space; the attractor organises recurrent behaviour that no single orbit exhausts. In the authorial psychic reading, what persists can be the organisation of transformation itself. Historical novelty therefore does not have to be the abandonment of every recurrent form.

[Complexes](C31-Complex.md) stabilise local affective organisations; symbols can intensify them, expose their boundaries, connect separated regions or enable a new regime. In [Taylor’s Van Eenwyk encounter](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors.md), an image’s response can reorganise associations and change the trajectory through which another image is encountered. A recurrent image is not automatically a strange attractor, and the technical definitions of attractor, basin and bifurcation retain their mathematical requirements.

## #4

Amplification and transformation do different work. Amplification moves among manifestations so that one partial view becomes readable through another; transformation changes the lived trajectory and its possibilities. A [world-atlas](../A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) relates partial disclosures through their transition conditions, while the basin/trajectory comparison follows the changed history through an organising field. An atlas is not an attractor. A shared motif alone establishes neither a transition map nor a common causal mechanism.

[Homological agreement and analogical proportion](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD-homology-and-analogy.md) preserve the whole relation in each telling: its actors, transformation, aftermath and limit. The myth's historical transmission and the operation it performs remain different questions. [Psychoid number](C30-Psychoid-Number.md) concerns efficacy across psychic and physical descriptions. A number’s occurrence in both gives that inquiry a particular object; efficacy requires evidence of what its use changes.

## #5→0

In the [mother–assumption chiasm](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mother-assumption-chiasm/WHOLE.md#mother-image-recognition-return), the encountered body, cope and corrected reading give determining capacity a situated maternal manifestation. Neumann’s morphology provides shared archetypal structuration while the local encounter retains its own history and cannot become a universal template.

In [Neumann’s morphology](../../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-round), the round, nurturing body, world-parent relation and transformed centre give shared genesis changing parental, bodily and heroic offices. Their situated tellings and temporal transformations retain their own histories. The [uroboric source variants](../../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-source-variants) let digestive enclosure, the world-parent bond and differentiating passage contribute through those distinct operations rather than becoming interchangeable pictures.

An archetypal interpretation returns to the life it has interpreted. [Image and valuation](../A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) make its acquired force answerable to what it opens or excludes; [individuation](../A21-Individuation-Recognition.md) transforms the relation among agencies. The outcome is not a completed catalogue of the archetype. A life recognises its own achieved differentiation within a wider ordering relation and becomes capable of another encounter.

[Cultural sensitivity to origins](../A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md) keeps the interpreted life and its sustaining conditions able to answer again. One culture’s image remains a particular contribution, rather than the universal form to which other lives must conform. Through pattern’s variable manifestations, [symbolic disclosure](C61-Symbolon-Disclosure-Architecture.md) differentiates formal relation, psychic transformation, whole telling and warranted historical account.
